Thurmont, Emmitsburg, Montgomery Village, Eldersburg, Ballenger
Creek, Redland, Mount Airy, Taneytown, Walkersville, Sykesville, New

Idaho Department of Environmental Quality in Lewiston
Nez Perce Tribe

wildfire smoke. Air Quality Index is forecast to be Unhealthy for
Sensitive Groups.

Perce Reservation.

* IMPACTS...Members of sensitive groups may experience health
effects. The general public is less likely to be affected.

events.source_name: US National Weather Service Active Alerts
events.summary:
FFWPBZ

The National Weather Service in Pittsburgh has issued a

* Flash Flood Warning for...
East Central Allegheny County in southwestern Pennsylvania...
Northwestern Westmoreland County in southwestern Pennsylvania...

* Until 615 PM EDT.

* At 319 PM EDT, Doppler radar indicated thunderstorms producing
heavy rain across the warned area. Between 1 and 1.5 inches of rain
have fallen. The expected rainfall rate is 0.75 to 1.5 inches in 1
hour. Additional rainfall amounts of 1 to 2 inches are possible in
the warned area. Flash flooding is ongoing or expected to begin
shortly.

highways, streets and underpasses as well as other poor
drainage and low-lying areas.

Side Pittsburgh, Murrysville, Wilkinsburg, New Kensington, Lower
Burrell, O'hara Township, Bellevue, Kennedy Township, West View,
